The bugs we’ve been putting off is starting to catch up to us now that we have 50 levels of solid play.

Gameplay issues:

- Level ends prematurely where as a boss spawns right as the win screen appears.
- Sometimes a boss would double spawn, throwing off level balance.
- Hard to reproduce, but sometimes a level will start and immediately end with zero monsters spawned (victory), and zero items spawned. This seems to happen depending on how the LAST level ended. This happens in editor and also live build.
- DoT effects applied incorrectly, burn for example deals 1st tick damage on contact unlike poison where the first tick damage happens at 1st second _after_ impact. Shock is unknown how it’s dealing damage.
- The damage numbers are off sometimes, it’s almost taking an aggregate amount from various sources but applying it as a single number during kill cam.

## 🧩 **Endless Mode – Engineering Summary**

### 🔧 Initial Setup

- Game starts with **40–45 sets** (a set = 3 items).
- **8 unique item types**, with size distribution:
  - 2 Large, 4 medium, 2 Small.
- Entire **item pool is defined by the designer** for each endless variant.
- Monsters also follow **30-second "tracks"**, authored by designers using level editor tools.

---

### 🔄 Refill System (Every 30 seconds)

1. **Track matched items** from the last 30 seconds.
2. **Refill those exact items** to keep total set count at 40–45.
3. Each refill is simulated and checked against a **growing Unique Item Cap**:

Refill #Time (s)Unique Cap130826093909412010.........1236014

---

### 🧠 Refill Logic Rules

1. **Simulate a refill**: Replace all matched items 1:1.
2. **Count unique items** on the new board.
3. If unique count is **below cap**:
   - Attempt to **substitute refilled items** with new unique items one-by-one.
   - After each substitution, re-check unique count.
4. If still short:
   - Remove a **fraction of total sets** = `#missingUniques / targetUniqueCap`.
   - Replace them with random sets using new unique items to reach the cap.

**Key principle:** Total number of sets never changes; only uniqueness does.

---

### 💥 New Mechanic: The Nuke (Replaces Boss Buster)

- **Builds power** by matching items:
  `NukePower += itemAttackPower × 10% × comboMultiplier`
- **Combo System**:
  - Starts at **1x**.
  - Combo meter fills after each match and **decays** over time.
  - If matched before timeout, combo increases.
  - Decay window shrinks by 0.25s each level (starts at 4.5s).
  - Max achievable combo: 18x.
  - The **next match** receives the combo multiplier shown.

input.title: [Reconciliation] Combo-Fighters / Zombie Match 3D — VFX & art import status (Dec 2025–Feb 2026)
input.description:
Reconciliation of the Combo-Fighters (= Zombie Match 3D) art/VFX import, walked from the repo PR history and cross-checked against the ZM ROADMAP Trello board. Created 2026-02-28 by V. Barnes because no pre-existing ART ticket tracks this import. If a canonical tracking ticket exists, fold this into it.

## Owner attribution (important — 3 different "Marcus" accounts)
- **Art/VFX author** on every `Marcus/*` branch and GitHub user "Marcus" = **Marcus Bennett** (marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co; Linear usr_c77c50cc15c5342d). This is confirmed by cross-referencing branch naming with ART-760 where Marcus Bennett names his own `Marcus/…` working branch. It is NOT Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@) and NOT the generic marcus@harmonygames.co account.
- **Integrator / merged most PRs** = Oliver Brooks (oliver.brooks@). Backend/analytics = Arthur Blake.

## The import PR itself
- **PR #1 "Marcus/importing art assets"** (Marcus Bennett) — still OPEN, DRAFT, label "do not merge", base `main` ← `Marcus/ImportingArtAssets`. Now reports **0 files / 0 additions changed** (feature branches have been collapsed; repo only has `main`). CodeRabbit's 2025-12-02 walkthrough confirms it was a pure Unity art/.meta asset import, no executable code. → This is a **draft PR with no diff** — nothing mergeable remains; it should be formally CLOSED, not left dangling.

## Real VFX that landed on the mainline and is verified on `main`
- **#33 Tiles Combo Highlight** (→ develop, merged 2026-01-26) — combo-highlight VFX system. `Combo_Vfx_Highlight.prefab` + `BoardOutlineManager.cs` CONFIRMED present on `main`. ✔
- **#16 Win-screen coin VFX** (→ develop, 2025-12-21) ✔
- **#22 New ground shadow** (→ develop, 2026-01-05) ✔
- **#27 Girl hero texture enhance** (→ develop, 2026-01-15) ✔ (minor)

## VFX that merged but is NOT on the mainline
- **#36 "vfx updates"** (Marcus Bennett, head `Marcus/playable_MaterialFix` → base **`playable`**, merged 2026-02-11) — post-processing Bloom volume + material fixes (~2,568 files). Merged into a `playable` branch, NOT develop/main. Bloom/post-processing NOT found on `main` via code search. → Real work, but currently NOT in production/`main`. If this is the "merged VFX branch" being cited as covering the import, its integration to main must be verified. **Integration owner: TBD.**

## Unmerged / closed-without-merge
- #32 (develop → Marcus/ImportingArtAssets) closed UNMERGED; #10 (develop → Marcus/ImportingArtAssets) closed UNMERGED; #20 (Debug Level Loader) closed unmerged, superseded by #21.

## Roadmap cross-check (ZM ROADMAP)
- Card "[Improvement] Equipped Card Item Infusion VFX implementation" (idShort 15) is marked dueComplete=true, but its "Workflow" checklist has **both items still INCOMPLETE**: "Marcus to create VFX" and "Engineer to implement" (last comment June 2025: "1 day, almost done"). No merged PR delivers item-infusion VFX. → genuinely NOT done. Left open; commented on the card.
- No merged-code evidence closes any VFX-deliverable checklist item, so none were checked off.

## Placeholder check
- No art placeholders found on `main` (only 3rd-party/library placeholders and standard Unity input-field placeholders). The prior "shipped 2 placeholder assets" risk is not currently reproduced on `main`.

## Bottom line re "treat the import as parked"
- Parking/closing draft PR #1 is defensible (0 diff, do-not-merge; curated VFX already merged via #16/#22/#27/#33 and #33 is confirmed on main).
- BUT "parked" ≠ "done": (a) #36 bloom/material work sits on `playable`, not main; (b) this roadmap Infusion VFX card is still open at the checklist level; (c) it could not be verified in Slack which Marcus told Leonard it was "covered." → Do not treat "import landed" as "no VFX work remains."

input.title: Combo-Fighters VFX/Art Import — Status Brief for Leonard (2026-02-28)
input.bodyText:
COMBO-FIGHTERS (ZOMBIE MATCH 3D) — VFX / ART IMPORT STATUS
Prepared by Victor Barnes • 2026-02-28 • for Leonard

CONTEXT
Leonard relayed (via Marcus) that the Combo-Fighters art-import PR is already covered by the merged VFX branch and can be treated as parked. This brief reconciles that against the actual repo state (PRs Dec 2025–Feb 2026) and the ZM roadmap.

SHORT ANSWER
Parking the draft import PR is reasonable. But "parked" is not the same as "done" — there is still real VFX work outstanding. Recommend we park the PR AND keep two open items owned before calling this closed.

WHAT ACTUALLY MERGED (and is verified on main)
- PR #33 Tiles Combo Highlight — combo-highlight VFX; prefab + script confirmed present on main.
- PR #16 Win-screen coin VFX — merged to develop.
- PR #22 New ground shadow — merged to develop.
- PR #27 Girl hero texture — merged (minor).
These are the "merged VFX" that legitimately cover parts of the import.

THE IMPORT PR (#1 "Marcus/importing art assets")
- Still OPEN as a DRAFT, labeled "do not merge."
- Now shows 0 changed files (the working branches have collapsed; the repo only has main). It was a pure Unity art/.meta import, no code.
- Action: this draft has nothing left to merge — it should be formally CLOSED, not left dangling. That part supports "treat it as parked."

WHAT IS NOT DONE (why we push back on "fully covered")
1. PR #36 "vfx updates" (bloom + material fixes, the big VFX branch) merged into a "playable" branch — NOT into develop/main. The bloom/post-processing is not on main. If this is the branch being cited as "covering" the import, its integration to main is unverified. Owner: TBD.
2. ZM roadmap card "Equipped Card Item Infusion VFX implementation" is marked done, but both checklist items are still open: "Marcus to create VFX" and "Engineer to implement." No merged PR delivers this. Owners: Marcus Bennett (VFX) + an engineer (implement).

OWNER ATTRIBUTION (note: 3 "Marcus" accounts exist)
- The art/VFX author on all Marcus/* branches = Marcus Bennett (marcus.bennett@). NOT Marcus Lee, NOT the generic marcus@ account.
- Merges/integration = Oliver Brooks.
- Could not verify in Slack which Marcus told Leonard it was "covered" — worth confirming.

PLACEHOLDER RISK
No art placeholder assets are sitting on main today (only library/UI-field placeholders). The prior "shipped 2 placeholders" situation is not currently reproduced.

RECOMMENDATION
- OK to close/park draft PR #1.
- Before treating the VFX import as finished, confirm: (a) is the #36 playable bloom/material work merged to main, and who owns that; (b) who owns the still-open Infusion VFX (create + implement).
- Full reconciliation is logged in Linear (ART reconciliation ticket) and on the affected ZM roadmap card.
